title: An integrated single cell and spatial transcriptomic map of human white adipose tissue
license_evidence: Article page 18 and the previously verified source dataset version 2 CC BY 4.0 license.
input_scope: Published already-computed deconvolution scores; no upstream bioinformatics analysis.
selection: All 16 Myeloid_* columns; all 15 Petrus participants and 37 Kerr participants. Baseline/2y main comparison; Kerr 5y retained for transfer.
time_mapping_evidence: Figure 8e caption on paper page 14 specifies baseline versus two years; workbook annotation sheet defines B baseline, C 2 years, D 5 years.
score_unit: Source-reported deconvolution score; its supplied normalization is preserved. Values are not reinterpreted as proportions.
transformations: Reshape selected workbook columns to tidy CSV, retaining source worksheet, Excel row and column.
Match within cohort and participant, subtract baseline from follow-up.
Compute sample median and linear quartiles of paired differences; compute percentage strictly below zero.
Order matrix columns by within-participant median change across all 16 displayed subtypes, separately by cohort.
Use published subtype descriptions from Figure 2d for row labels and display groups.
limitations: IQR is participant dispersion, not a confidence interval.
No causal effect estimate or inferential test is added.
Cohort deconvolution scores retain source normalization; their summary differences do not estimate an adjusted cohort effect.
The transfer evaluation changes time point and cohort selection within the same study source; it is not an independent study or arbitrary-schema test.
